cards.ex: They're fighting tooth and nail to protect the environment from further damage.
cards.exUz: Ular atrof-muhitni yanada zarardan himoya qilish uchun jon-jahdi bilan kurashmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Qattiq va juda ko'p kuch sarflab kurashmoq; bor kuchini ishga solmoq.

cards.ex: Legalizing euthanasia could be a slippery slope towards devaluing human life.
cards.exUz: Evtanaziyani qonuniylashtirish inson hayotini qadrsizlantirishga olib kelishi mumkin bo'lgan sirpanchiq yo'l bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli vaziyatga olib kelishi mumkin bo'lgan harakatlar ketma-ketligi.

cards.ex: Too many vulnerable children are falling through the cracks in the social care system.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy ta'minot tizimida juda ko'p himoyasiz bolalar e'tibordan chetda qolmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Yordamga muhtoj bo'lishiga qaramay, tizim tomonidan yordam berilmaslik.

cards.ex: The report documented numerous violations of rights during the conflict.
cards.exUz: Hisobotda mojarolar davrida ko'plab huquq buzilishlari qayd etilgan.
cards.uzDef: Insonning qonuniy huquqlarini buzish yoki hurmat qilmaslik.

cards.ex: The new evidence calls into question the defendant's alibi.
cards.exUz: Yangi dalillar ayblanuvchining oqlanishini shubha ostiga qo'yadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning to'g'riligi, ishonchliligi yoki adolatliligiga shubha bildirish.

cards.ex: The pandemic was a wake-up call about the importance of public health.
cards.exUz: Pandemiya jamoat salomatligining muhimligi haqida ogohlantiruvchi qo'ng'iroq bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmagan hodisa, vaziyatga jiddiy e'tibor qaratish zarurligini ko'rsatadigan.

cards.ex: We need to address the root causes of poverty, not just the symptoms.
cards.exUz: Biz kambag'allikning faqat alomatlariga emas, balki asosiy sabablariga ham e'tibor qaratishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoning asosiy, chuqur ildiz otgan sabablari.

cards.ex: Campaigners are fighting an uphill battle to change public opinion on the issue.
cards.exUz: Targ'ibotchilar bu masala bo'yicha jamoatchilik fikrini o'zgartirish uchun qiyin kurash olib borishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Muayyan maqsadga erishishda juda ko'p qiyinchiliklarga duch kelish.

cards.ex: The influx of refugees has put a strain on the social fabric of the community.
cards.exUz: Qochqinlarning oqimi jamiyatning ijtimoiy tuzilmasiga bosim o'tkazdi.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatni tashkil etuvchi munosabatlar, e'tiqodlar va urf-odatlar.

cards.ex: Technology is a double-edged sword; it can connect us, but also isolate us.
cards.exUz: Texnologiya ikki tig'li qilichdir; u bizni bog'lashi ham, ajratishi ham mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ham foyda, ham zarar keltirishi mumkin bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: Increased investment in education could help turn the tide against poverty.
cards.exUz: Ta'limga ko'proq sarmoya kiritish kambag'allikka qarshi vaziyatni o'zgartirishga yordam berishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatning yo'nalishini o'zgartirish, ayniqsa yomon vaziyatni yaxshilash.

cards.ex: We need to ensure that women are on an equal footing with men in the workplace.
cards.exUz: Biz ish joyida ayollarning erkaklar bilan teng sharoitda bo'lishini ta'minlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Teng imkoniyatlar va sharoitlarga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: Many families are fighting for survival in the face of rising living costs.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina oilalar hayot qimmatlashuvi sharoitida o'z hayoti uchun kurashmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Yashash uchun kurashish, ayniqsa qiyin sharoitlarda.

cards.ex: The social divide between rich and poor is growing wider.
cards.exUz: Boylar va kambag'allar o'rtasidagi ijtimoiy tafovut tobora kengayib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatdagi odamlarning turli guruhlariga bo'linishi, farqlar tufayli.

cards.ex: Their pleas for help were falling on deaf ears.
cards.exUz: Ularning yordam so'rab qilgan murojaatlari e'tiborsiz qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar tinglamaydigan yoki e'tibor bermaydigan narsa.

cards.ex: Poverty and lack of education create a vicious cycle that's hard to break.
cards.exUz: Kambag'allik va ta'limning yetishmasligi yopiq doirani yaratadi, uni buzish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Yomon natijalarga olib keladigan va ularni kuchaytiradigan bir qator voqealar.

cards.ex: Environmental concerns often take a backseat to economic development.
cards.exUz: Atrof-muhit muammolari ko'pincha iqtisodiy rivojlanish oldida ikkinchi darajaga tushadi.
cards.uzDef: Muhimligini yo'qotish yoki birinchi o'ringa chiqmaslik.

cards.ex: The politician found himself in the crosshairs after his controversial remarks.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi bahsli so'zlaridan keyin o'zini nishonda topdi.
cards.uzDef: Tanqid yoki hujumning maqsadi bo'lish.

cards.ex: The right to assembly is a fundamental democratic freedom.
cards.exUz: Yig'ilish huquqi fundamental demokratik erkindir.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarning tinch yo'l bilan uchrashish va yig'ilish huquqi.

cards.ex: These isolated incidents are just the tip of the iceberg of a much larger problem.
cards.exUz: Ushbu yakka hodisalar ancha katta muammoning aysbergning uchidir.
cards.uzDef: Kattaroq, yashirin muammoning kichik bir qismi.

cards.ex: Many good ideas fall by the wayside due to lack of funding.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina yaxshi g'oyalar mablag'ning yetishmasligi sababli amalga oshmay qoladi.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatga erisha olmaslik yoki amalga oshmaslik.

cards.ex: She overcame her underprivileged background to become a successful doctor.
cards.exUz: U nochorgina muhitdan kelib chiqqaniga qaramay, muvaffaqiyatli shifokor bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin iqtisodiy sharoitlarga ega bo'lgan oiladan kelib chiqish.

cards.ex: The community closed ranks to support the family after the tragedy.
cards.exUz: Jamiyat fojia yuz bergandan keyin oilani qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun safni zichlashtirdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin paytlarda birgalikda ishlash va bir-birini qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: The organization is at a crossroads and needs to decide its future direction.
cards.exUz: Tashkilot chorrahada turibdi va kelajakdagi yo'nalishini hal qilishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muhim qaror qabul qilish kerak bo'lgan vaziyatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: She dedicated her life to fighting for environmental causes.
cards.exUz: U hayotini atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish maqsadlariga bag'ishladi.
cards.uzDef: Muhim deb hisoblangan maqsadga erishish uchun harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Social exclusion can lead to feelings of isolation and depression.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy chetlatish izolyatsiya va tushkunlik hissini keltirib chiqarishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarning jamiyat hayotida to'liq ishtirok eta olmasligi.

cards.ex: There's a lack of representation of women in senior management positions.
cards.exUz: Yuqori lavozimlarda ayollarning vakilligi yetarli emas.
cards.uzDef: Bir guruhning vakolatli organlarda yetarlicha vakil bo'lmasligi.

cards.ex: Politics is often a touchy subject at family gatherings.
cards.exUz: Siyosat ko'pincha oilaviy yig'ilishlarda nozik mavzu hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Bahsga sabab bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan yoki odamlarni xafa qilishi mumkin bo'lgan mavzu.

cards.ex: The new law threatens our right to privacy.
cards.exUz: Yangi qonun shaxsiy hayot huquqimizga tahdid solmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy ma'lumotlar va hayotning maxfiyligini himoya qilish huquqi.

cards.ex: She's at the forefront of the fight against climate change.
cards.exUz: U iqlim o'zgarishiga qarshi kurashning oldingi saflarida.
cards.uzDef: Muhim faoliyatning eng oldingi saflarida bo'lish.
